EmailTemplate.subject: Is team spirit in your blood? Prove it.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Donor,
This fall, you can help fight against blood shortage by participating in the largest blood donation competition of our lifetime. <<School/Organization name>> is proud to participate in “The We Give Blood Drive,” sponsored by Abbott and the Big Ten Conference®. We’re calling on all students, alumni and fans to show their school spirit by donating blood with The American Red Cross. You can help rebuild the nation’s blood supply while supporting our school in a conference-wide blood donation competition. Help our school win!
Donors at your upcoming blood drive can enter to win tickets to the 2024 Discover Big Ten Football Championship Game on December 7, 2024 by submitting their donation online. * The school atop the leaderboard at the conclusion of the challenge can win $1 million to advance student or community health.
Joining the fight can be done in these easy steps:
1. Visit redcrossblood.org/give to schedule your Red Cross blood donation appointment – enter Sponsor Code <XXXXX>
2. Submit your donation on behalf of our school at www.bigten.org/abbott/submit
For more information, visit www.bigten.org/abbott.
*This offer and any resulting prize during the competition are non-transferable and not redeemable for cash. Visit https://bigten.votigo.com/fbsweeps/pages/BigTenWeGiveBloodSweepstakes/rules for the terms and conditions of the sweepstakes.
The American Red Cross is not a sponsor of the sweepstakes and is not responsible for the creation, execution or fulfillment of the We Give Blood Drive, or any aspect of the prize. This communication does not constitute an endorsement, express or implied, of any product, service, company, opinion or political position.
